title: Log Analytics workspaces, retention and the cost of ingestion

videos.script: Every log line routed in lesson 8 lands in a workspace. {{workspace}} The workspace is a database you query in KQL, and you pay for it by the gigabyte that arrives. Not by the query. By the arrival. {{arrival}} So the question that matters is how much arrives, and how long you keep it. {{retention}} You cannot create a workspace without a subscription. You can run the same query engine on your own computer, and that is what this lesson installs. Then you load a week of the shop's requests and measure how big they are. {{end}}
